name: Walpole Extended Day Summer Camp
operator_name: Walpole Public Schools Extended Day Program
description_short: Four week summer day camp run by the Walpole Public Schools Extended Day Program at Fisher Elementary School for Walpole students entering grades 1 to 6, booked by the week with optional morning and afternoon care.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp 2026: four weeks at Fisher Elementary School for incoming grade 1 to 6 Walpole students; individual weeks or all four at a discount.
